note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). Convertible to skill-creator's eval format; run via its description-tuning loop or manual fresh-session baseline. Known accepted-leak class (eval-run 2026-07-09): cases whose true owner is a user-only command leak to this standards skill on a model-only menu — the standards loading as background for a forge-shaped ask is benign (the model then suggests the command). Do not tune the description to chase these.

cases.prompt: How should I write the description for this skill?
Why does my skill never trigger even though it's installed?
What's the right length for a SKILL.md body?
What belongs in the description vs the body vs references/?
How do disable-model-invocation and user-invocable interact?
My skill stopped influencing behavior mid-session — why?
Should this be a knowledge skill or a command?
Review this skill and give me a findings report
Forge me a new deploy skill
Make this prompt actually change the model's behavior
should we consolidate these three thin skills into one
how should the reference corpus and INDEX behind this skill be structured
